subject: POV launch playbook & access milestones — ClearPathAI
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearpathai.com>, Samantha Reeves <samantha.reeves@clearpathai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: POV launch playbook & access milestones — ClearPathAI

Hi Liam / Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Brief recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source-of-truth as we prep for the POV kickoff: 

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Inference variability at peak: 95th percentile generation latency spikes during batch processing windows.
- Cost predictability: engineering needs a bounded cost per 1k tokens for production-like workloads.
- Data handling: a subset of prompts contain PII and you need clear controls and logs for audit.

Goals for the 4-week POV (proposed):
1) Demonstrate stable 95th-percentile latency <= 220ms for the 512-token median prompts under a 50 rps sustained load.
2) Quantify cost per 1k tokens for the chosen model/quantization profile.
3) Deliver a prompt-eval suite (sanity + edge cases) and quality baseline so we can monitor regression.

Proposed scope and owners:
- ClearPathAI: Liam (product owner), Samantha (IT/procurement), procurement@clearpathai.com (billing/procurement).
- Redwood: Diego (AE, kickoff owner), Monica (Customer Success — evals & prompt set), Aditya (Infra/serving configuration).

Success metrics (we'll instrument these in the console):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for generation and for prefix caching hit rate
- Cost: $ per 1k tokens at observed throughput
- Quality: pass rate on the supplied prompt-eval suite (baseline + top-5 regression checks)

High-level timeline (target kickoff next week if we can get access):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm scope, sign off on access matrix, nominate owners.
- Week 1: Provision environment (hosted or dedicated dev pool), upload sample prompt set, initial smoke tests.
- Week 2: Run scaled runs for latency/cost profiling, iterate on batching and cache settings.
- Week 3: Prompt set evals and quality regression checks.
- Week 4: Final readout & recommendation (model variant + quantization + routing policy).

Access / setup asks (what we need from ClearPathAI):
- S3 bucket or secure file drop with sample prompt set (500–1,000 items recommended)
- Service account or short-lived API key for the POV (we will provide minimum-privilege instructions)
- Network allowlist (we'll provide IP ranges) and, if applicable, VPN details for private deployment.

Attachments: redwood_pov_scope_v1.pdf (scope + success metrics), network_access_matrix.xlsx (access checklist).

Please confirm the above, share the preferred kickoff window (I can block 60–90 minutes), and let us know if procurement needs a formal SOW first — happy to loop in legal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Diego — thanks for the crisp summary. All of the above looks right to us. A couple of clarifying questions before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Prompt set size — you recommend 500–1,000. Is 750 a safe middle ground? We have a corpus we can sample from and will scrub PII before drop.
2) Deployment mode — we prefer to start hosted for speed, but if dedicated is strongly recommended for latency guarantees can you outline the delta in time/cost?

Also attaching our security questionnaire for your review (clearpath_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf) — Samantha, can you confirm who on your side will take the info security review?

Kickoff availability: Thu 8/13 10:00–11:30 or Fri 8/14 13:00–14:30 (PST).

Liam

Liam — great, 750 is perfect. We'll ask for a stratified sample across your top 3 user flows so the evals are representative. 

Deployment guidance (short):
- Hosted API (fastest): we can stand up a dev pool within 24–48 hours; good for feature validation but latency may vary at high sustained load.
- Dedicated (recommended for strict p95 SLOs): reserved GPU pool, predictable contention characteristics; typically adds ~3–5 business days to provision depending on region and adds a fixed monthly reservation cost for the POV window. We can provide a short cost estimate.

Next steps I can take now:
- Share a writable Drive folder and the detailed POV access playbook with exact API key/service-account steps and our IP ranges (link below).
- Monica will follow up to collect the prompt-eval template and define pass/fail thresholds.
- Aditya will prepare a dev queue and reserve a test slot for the kickoff.

Drive folder (read/write): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_clearpath-pov
Attachment: pov_access_playbook.md (detailed access steps & minimum-privilege template)

If Thu 8/13 10:00 PST works, we'll use that as the default kickoff and send an invite — I can also push to Friday if procurement needs more time.

Diego
